name: Neuroscience PhD
summary: Research PhD in neuroscience, with either first-year lab rotations or an initial faculty adviser.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. December 15 is undated. Students may enter with an adviser or rotate before selecting one.

documents: Statement of purpose describing goals, research interests, faculty fit and preparation

applicationFee.note: International $95; domestic $60, nonrefundable and nontransferable. No neuroscience waiver route established.

english.toefl: 79 iBT/Home Edition or Essentials 8.5 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 iBT after
english.note: PTE 59 or Cambridge 176 also accepted. Central exemptions for US citizen or citizenship/earned degree in listed English-speaking countries; confirm country. Program may set additional standards. Central page uses before/after January 21, 2026 wording without resolving that exact boundary; confirm if tested that day.

requirements.note: GPA 3 minimum; MS not required, apply directly to PhD. GRE recent scores recommended, not required. First year may involve rotations or direct work with initial faculty adviser; contact prospective faculty with CV and short interests statement.

funding.note: Fall entrants guaranteed first-year funding through TA/RA, continued support subject to good standing and progress. Spring entrants require individual faculty-grant funding. Assistantship tuition waiver depends on appointment level; program/department/faculty cover significant additional costs such as health care. No stipend amount stated.
